newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash soybeans sag in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash soybeans sag in slow trade.

text.p: Argentine cash soybeans were lower in slow midsession trade at Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, as prices slipped after falls in nearby Chicago, traders said.

The FAS elevator soybean price in Rosario lost $2 to $293. Maize was mainly unchanged in good volume harvest time trade. Buenos Aires FAS elevator maize was steady at $108. Sunflower seed lost $2 in Rosario to $226 and $1 in the southern ports of Bahia Blanca and Quequen to $221, as a result of muted demand. Wheat slipped $4 in Quequen to $160, with local millers the sole, and unenthusiastic, buyers.
